enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Blurry: Equipping this item causes you to become slightly blurry. Attacks from enemies have a 20% chance to miss you due to concealment.
Ethereal: Equipping this item causes your hands and weapons to become partially incorporeal. Your melee attacks do not roll a miss chance for Incorporeal targets.
Improved False Life: This item grants the wearer +20 maximum health.

Insightful Sneak Attack Bonus +1 : Provides a +1 Insightful modifier to your attack bonus and a +2 Insightful bonus to damage for any attack that would qualify as a Sneak Attack, even if the wielder is not a Rogue.
Heightened Awareness 3: This item helps you to quickly read situations with sharpness and clarity, allowing you to predict actions before they occur. You gain a +3 Insight bonus to AC.
Mythic Armor Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
